title: Pāʻia 40-acre housing project rezoning
summary: On Nov. 18, council members added conditions to the EC Pāʻia Town project: no bed and breakfast or timeshare use, permanent owner-occupancy for gap-group homes, and vegetation management for fire. Members also questioned why the project's water-use numbers differ from the county water department's. The Planning Commission recommended approval in September for the 40.392-acre rezoning, which covers about 170 homes, including at least 34 permanently affordable workforce rentals.
